transcriptional_regulation_jaspar_unibin.summary: Direct TF-DNA ChIP-seq binding datasets (UniBind) and Position Weight Matrices (JASPAR CORE Taxon 9606) demonstrating how S/G2M cell-cycle regulators (E2F1, E2F4, FOXM1, MYC) and lineage/checkpoint TFs (SOX2, TP53, STAT3) co-regulate replication-coupled chromatin, DNA repair, and stemness programs.

literature_citations_europepmc.summary: Peer-reviewed benchmark studies demonstrating that linear/OLS cell-cycle regression (Scanpy regress_out / Seurat ScaleData vars.to.regress) erases biological fate, neural progenitor differentiation, and tumor proliferation-coupled plasticity.

tri_modal_convergence_headline.conclusion: Standard single-cell and spatial pipelines inflict a compound Triple Catastrophe on proliferation-coupled oncogenic amplicons and invasive-margin receptors: (1) OLS cell-cycle regression erases 15%-80% of RNA driver variance, (2) 15-bin CNV smoothing washes out 61%-94% of sub-megabase DNA amplicon spires, and (3) isotropic spatial smoothing fabricates +241%-417% false-positive pseudo-EMT hybrids while collapsing trans-membrane juxtacrine polarity up to 38.76-fold. cellsnail v0.2.0 eliminates all three failure modes simultaneously.
